help.title: How Trikatuka works
help.intro: Trikatuka moves your playlists, liked songs, albums, followed artists and podcasts from one Spotify account to another. It runs entirely in your browser: your data and tokens never go to any other server.
help.ruleCopy: Playlists you created are copied: the new account gets its own playlist with the same name, visibility, description and songs.
help.ruleFollow: Collaborative playlists and playlists made by others are followed by the new account.
help.ruleLocal: Local files can't be copied through Spotify's API and are left out.
help.step1: Sign in with the old account.
help.step2: Sign in with the new account.
help.step4: Review the options and start. Keep the tab open until it finishes.
help.order: Spotify sorts liked songs by the moment they were saved. With “Keep the order” enabled, songs are saved one per second, oldest first, so the new account shows them in the same order. It takes longer.

privacy.englishOnly: This policy is available in English only.
